This matter is taken up through Hybrid
arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application for bail under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Soro P.S. Case No.458 of 2012 corresponding to S.T. Case No.11 of 2018, 29/2021 pending in the Court of learned Adhoc Addl. Sessions Judge (F.T.S.C.), Balasore for alleged commission of offences under sections 341/341/ 376(2)(f) of the I.P.C. and section 4 of the POCSO Act.
The prayer for bail of the petitioner has been rejected by the learned Adhoc Addl. Sessions Judge (F.T.S.C.), Balasore by order dated 14.12.2022.

Perused the status report furnished by the learned trial Court dated 08.07.2024 wherein it is mentioned that the progress of the case is delayed because there are five investigating officers in this case and on account of general election, summer vacation followed by curfew in Balasore Town, the trial could not be proceeded expeditiously and that the Court required two months time for disposal Jada @ Hatada Nayak @ vs State Of Odisha ....

The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of as withdrawn.
The order be communicated to the learned trial Court forthwith.
